subject: social_studies
concept: Applying culture, multiple identities, stereotypes, migration, and comparison to a real-world reflective project, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a simple personal identity map showing the multiple groups and cultural elements that make up who they are
exercise.abstract: Student presents their identity map and explains at least one thing they've learned about identity from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: map reflects multiple genuine identity elements and the explanation connects to a real unit concept
misconception_flags: presents only a single flat identity category with no genuine reflection on multiplicity

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
